title: Site & Service Health — Home / Oracle / Canada
description: Single-glance view of the PantryBot multi-site failover project's three sites (tracked separately in issue #191 / pantry-bot#147 -- this dashboard only consumes signals that project already exposes, it does not implement any of it). Built 2026-09-21 by directly checking, live, what this Prometheus can and cannot currently answer: Home is this k3s cluster and is fully instrumented via kube-state-metrics/cAdvisor plus the per-microservice /metrics scrape jobs. Oracle currently has NO presence in this Prometheus at all -- no site="oracle" label exists anywhere (verified via /api/v1/label/site/values) -- so every 'is Oracle up' question is answered honestly as unknown, not faked. Canada has exactly one scrape target defined (job=canada-pantry-bot-api, role=recovery, tunnelled to this host's 192.168.40.208:13101) and it is not currently returning fresh samples; there is no Alloy/windows_exporter-style host telemetry for Canada the way Greenie's PC has. The failover-witness service's own /metrics (failover_witness_lease_active, failover_witness_lease_epoch) is also not currently scraped by this Prometheus -- a scrape job for it exists in observability/prometheus-config.yaml but has not been deployed to the live ConfigMap as of this audit -- so this dashboard cannot show which site currently holds the fencing lease either. Where the answer is 'unknown from here', this dashboard says so instead of omitting the question.

panels.title: Home Nodes Ready
panels.description: Ready condition across every node kube-state-metrics knows about in this cluster (not hardcoded to one node name -- this cluster has had a second node, chasebot, come and go).

panels.title: PantryBot Microservices Up (Home)
panels.description: up{} for every pantry-bot-* scrape job at site="home" (api, gateway, dispatcher, worker). 0/no-row means that service's /metrics endpoint is not responding right now -- during an active failover rehearsal or a genuine incident this is expected to show 0s; cross-check against kubectl / the Pantry Bot dashboards before treating it as a surprise.

panels.title: Ready PantryBot Pods (Home)
panels.description: Across every pantry-bot microservice, including cloudflared and postgres.

panels.title: Postgres Pod Present (Home) — name-based, not authoritative
panels.description: Counts pods in the pantry-bot namespace whose name starts with 'postgres-'. This tells you a Postgres pod is currently scheduled at Home; it does NOT tell you whether it is primary or a replica, or currently healthy -- Postgres StatefulSet/pod names have been renamed multiple times during the failover project, and no primary/replica role is currently exposed as a Prometheus label (checked kube_pod_labels for a pantrybot.postgres/role-style label; none exists as of this audit). Use the PantryBot ops runbook or the witness's own state for an authoritative answer.

panels.title: Oracle is not instrumented into this Prometheus

options.content: **Verified live on 2026-09-21**: `label_values(up, site)` returns only `canada`, `home`, and `windows-remote` -- there is no `oracle` site anywhere in this Prometheus's series. Oracle's k3s cluster is not federated, remote-written, or otherwise scraped into this instance, so **no panel here can honestly answer whether Oracle is up**. If/when Oracle gains a scrape or remote-write path into this Prometheus (federation, an Alloy forwarder, or a direct scrape job with `site="oracle"`), add real panels here instead of a placeholder. Until then, check Oracle directly or via whatever the multi-site failover project (#191 / pantry-bot#147) already uses for that.

panels.title: Canada Recovery Endpoint Reachable
panels.description: up{job="canada-pantry-bot-api"}. This is a single tunnelled scrape target (role="recovery", reached via 192.168.40.208:13101, i.e. proxied back through the Home host) for one PantryBot API surface at Canada -- it is not a general Canada host-up signal. As of this audit it has no fresh samples (target not currently reporting); NO DATA here means 'not currently scraping successfully', not necessarily 'Canada is down'.

options.content: Canada is a Windows/Docker host outside Kubernetes. Greenie's Main PC proves the pattern for getting a Windows host's own health (CPU/memory/disk/GPU) into this Prometheus via Grafana Alloy remote-write (`site="windows-remote"`, see the Greenie's Main PC — Health dashboard). **As of this audit, Canada has no equivalent path wired up** -- the only thing this Prometheus knows about Canada is the single `canada-pantry-bot-api` recovery-role scrape target above, which speaks to one application endpoint, not host health. If Canada host-level monitoring is wanted, the fastest route is standing up the same Alloy remote-write pattern already proven for Greenie's PC.

panels.title: Failover-witness lease holder — not currently queryable here

options.content: `observability/failover-witness/witness.py` exposes `/metrics` with `failover_witness_lease_active{resource,holder}` and `failover_witness_lease_epoch{resource}` -- exactly the 'who currently holds authority' signal this dashboard would want. **It is not currently scraped by this Prometheus.** A `pantry-postgres-witness` scrape job targeting `failover-witness-relay.observability.svc.cluster.local:18765` already exists in `observability/prometheus-config.yaml` in this repo, but the *live* `prometheus-config` ConfigMap on the cluster does not have it yet (checked directly, 2026-09-21) -- so it has not been deployed. This dashboard change intentionally does not deploy that scrape config itself: touching live Prometheus scrape config is outside 'dashboards only' scope, and a production failover rehearsal is in progress elsewhere in this repo's infrastructure right now. The panel below is wired to the correct metric name so it starts working the moment that job goes live; until then it will show no data, which is the honest state.

panels.title: Fencing Lease Holder (once scraped)
panels.description: failover_witness_lease_active{resource,holder}. holder is one of home/oracle/canada/none. Will show no data until the pantry-postgres-witness scrape job above is deployed.
